name: Agentix Brute Force Response (T1110)
description: Automated SOAR playbook for MITRE T1110 (Brute Force). Flow: Wazuh alert → parse auth failures → check successful login → Cortex IP enrichment → TheHive case creation → conditional: block IP + disable account if compromise confirmed.

actions.name: Wazuh Brute Force Webhook
actions.label: trigger_webhook
actions.description: Receives Wazuh brute force alert (rule 5710/5712) via HTTP webhook.

actions.name: Parse Brute Force Alert
actions.label: parse_brute_force
actions.description: Extracts source IP, targeted user, failure count, and rule ID from the Wazuh brute force alert.

parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json
alert = json.loads("$exec")
rule_id = alert.get('rule', {}).get('id', 'unknown')
rule_desc = alert.get('rule', {}).get('description', 'Brute force detected')
agent_id = alert.get('agent', {}).get('id', '000')
agent_name = alert.get('agent', {}).get('name', 'unknown')
src_ip = alert.get('data', {}).get('srcip', alert.get('agent', {}).get('ip', ''))
target_user = alert.get('data', {}).get('dstuser', alert.get('data', {}).get('user', 'unknown'))
timestamp = alert.get('timestamp', '')
# Brute force rules: 5710 (SSH), 5712 (SSH repeated), 2501 (PAM), 2502 (multiple auth failures)
result = {
    'rule_id': rule_id,
    'rule_desc': rule_desc,
    'agent_id': agent_id,
    'agent_name': agent_name,
    'src_ip': src_ip,
    'target_user': target_user,
    'timestamp': timestamp,
    'is_brute_force': rule_id in ['5710', '5712', '5716', '2501', '2502', '100010']
}
print(json.dumps(result))

actions.name: Query Wazuh – Check Successful Login
actions.label: check_successful_login
actions.description: Queries Wazuh Indexer (Elasticsearch) to check if any successful login occurred from the brute force source IP within the last 5 minutes.

actions.name: Cortex IP Reputation
actions.label: cortex_ip_enrichment
actions.description: Submits brute force source IP to Cortex VirusTotal analyzer.

actions.name: Create TheHive Case
actions.label: create_thehive_case
actions.description: Creates a TheHive case using the MITRE T1110 template. Severity adjusted based on whether a successful login was found.

parameters.name: body
parameters.value:
{"title": "[T1110] Brute Force Attack from $step_1_parse_alert.src_ip on $step_1_parse_alert.agent_name", "description": "**MITRE ATT&CK T1110 – Brute Force**

- **Source IP:** $step_1_parse_alert.src_ip
- **Target User:** $step_1_parse_alert.target_user
- **Agent:** $step_1_parse_alert.agent_name ($step_1_parse_alert.agent_id)
- **Rule:** $step_1_parse_alert.rule_id – $step_1_parse_alert.rule_desc
- **Timestamp:** $step_1_parse_alert.timestamp
- **Cortex Job:** $step_3_cortex_enrichment.id
- **Successful Login Check:** $step_2_check_success.hits.total.value hits

Automated response by Agentix Shuffle SOAR.", "severity": 3, "tlp": 2, "pap": 2, "tags": ["mitre", "t1110", "brute-force", "agentix"]}

actions.name: Block Brute Force Source IP
actions.label: block_source_ip
actions.description: Calls Agentix SOC Agent MCP API to block the brute force source IP via the firewall tool. NOTE: This step requires human approval gate — the Agentix API enforces operator confirmation.

actions.name: Update TheHive Case – Actions Taken
actions.label: update_thehive_case
actions.description: Adds a task log to the TheHive case documenting all automated actions taken.

parameters.name: body
parameters.value:
